title: Best pair at distance K
prompt: Specification: best_pair(xs, k) returns the maximum sum xs[i] + xs[j] over all i < j with j - i >= k. All values are positive and at least one valid pair exists. Select the implementation that satisfies the specification.

candidates.code:
def best_pair(xs, k):
    best = 0
    prefix = xs[0]
    for j in range(k, len(xs)):
        prefix = max(prefix, xs[j - k])
        best = max(best, prefix + xs[j])
    return best
